app.stop_confirm.title: Confirm shutdown

This sends shutdown: a maintenance notice is broadcast to all players first, then the server shuts down gracefully.

If automatic restart is enabled, this shutdown will not trigger a restart.

Continue?
app.close.title: Server still running
app.close.body:
Send shutdown to the server before closing the tool?
(A maintenance notice is broadcast first, then the server exits gracefully)

Choose No to close only the tool and leave the server running.

app.language.restart_failed: The language was saved, but the tool could not restart automatically. Please close and reopen it.
overview.title: Overview
overview.desc: Server status, data source health, and recent operations. Every write operation backs up the database first.
overview.todo.banned.title: {count} active bans
overview.todo.banned.text: Double-click a ban row to unban; silent bans do not tell the client the reason.
overview.todo.shop.title: Shop changes not reloaded
overview.todo.shop.text: After saving Shop.json, a dbreload is required before clients see the changes.
overview.todo.server.title: Server not running
overview.todo.server.text: Use the top bar to start it; supervision takes over restart-on-crash after startup.
overview.todo.none.title: Nothing to do
overview.todo.none.text: The server is running normally; configuration and shop have no pending changes.
users.title: User Management
users.desc: Search accounts, modify values, and view inventories. Changes to online users are sent as GM commands; offline users are written directly to the database.
users.col.name: Nickname
users.select_hint: Select an account in the list on the left
users.online_hint: This user is online. Changes will be sent as givepoints / addexp commands instead of writing to the database.
users.offline_hint: This user is offline. Values are written directly to the database and take effect on next login.
users.select_user: Please select a user on the left first
users.invalid_numbers: Points / EXP / level must be integers
users.online_warning.title: User is online
users.online_warning.body:
This user is currently online. Direct database edits would be overwritten by the server's in-memory values.

Send GM commands on the Runtime & Logs page, for example:
  givepoints {uid} <delta>
  addexp {uid} <delta>
users.saved.title: Done
users.saved.body: Written to the database; the user will see the change on next login.
users.online_points.title: Sent
users.online_points.body: GM command sent; see the Runtime & Logs page for the result.
users.clear_confirm.title: Confirm clear
items.title: Item Delivery
items.desc: Search the full item database by internal name / localized name / alias / category. Stacking and inventory usage are simulated before delivery.
items.col.name: Localized name
items.tip.fill_user: Enter a target user and click Select first
items.online.title: User is online
bans.title: Ban Management
bans.desc: Three channels: account / IP / HWID. Triple ban writes all three at once so the player cannot return with another account. Online users must be kicked manually after banning.
bans.col.name: Nickname
bans.banned.title: Banned
bans.banned.body: {name}'s account has been banned for {days} days
bans.triple.title: Triple banned
bans.unban_confirm.title: Confirm unban
bans.unban_confirm.body:
Unban {name}?

Account, IP, and HWID bans will all be removed.
bans.unbanned.title: Unbanned
bans.kick.title: Manual kick required
bans.kick.body:
This user is currently online. The account is banned, but the server still has the in-memory session.

There is no single-user kick command; ask the user to log in again, or kick them from the Session page of the server GUI.
bans.online.title: User is online
bans.online.body: The user appears online, but the server is not managed by this tool. The ban will take effect on next login.
shop.title: Shop Management
shop.desc: Edit products and tiers (sub-products). After saving, a dbreload is required before clients see the changes.
shop.warning: Do not use shopreload—it does not clear the old list, so every execution duplicates products (47 → 94 → 141 → 188), and clients see duplicate products and shifted tiers. The only correct hot reload is dbreload.
shop.col.name: Item name
shop.one_item: A tier can sell only one item
shop.hint.dirty: ⚠ Modified but not reloaded: clients still see the old shop and purchases are settled at the old price. Click "Reload shop" in the top right.
shop.hint.none: Select a product above, then edit its tiers. Quantity = items per purchase; days = duration (0 = permanent); price = points or cash.
shop.hint.currency:
The current product {pid} uses {currency}; prices in the table below are in {currency}. Remember to save and reload after editing.
"Clan bonus" is only parsed by the server, never written back or settled, so it has no effect; limits: price 4294967295, quantity 65535, days 32767, badge 255. Out-of-range values are truncated by the server, so the tool blocks them.
shop.tier_missing: Please select a product above first
shop.tier_select: Please select a tier in the table below first (double-click to load it into the form)
shop.tier_select_copy: Please select a tier to duplicate first
shop.tier_select_delete: Please select a tier to delete first
shop.cannot_delete.title: Cannot delete
shop.cannot_delete.body:
A product must keep at least 1 tier, otherwise players cannot buy it.

If you do not want to sell this product, use "Delete product".
shop.delete_tier.title: Confirm tier deletion
shop.item_not_exist.title: Item does not exist
shop.item_not_exist.body:
itemID {pid} is not in Item.csv.

When a player buys it, the server will return BUY_FAIL_SYSTEM_ERROR.
Continue?
shop.currency_updated: itemID {pid} is already in the shop; currency type updated.
shop.item_added: itemID {pid} has been added with one default tier (1 item / 30 days / 1000).
shop.added.title: Added
shop.delete_confirm.title: Confirm deletion
shop.validate_failed.title: Validation failed
shop.validate_failed.body:
Shop.json was not saved; the following problems were found:

{problems}
shop.saved.title: Saved
shop.saved.body:
Shop.json has been written.

Next you must click "Reload shop", otherwise online players will still buy at the old price.
shop.reload.no_server.title: Server not running
shop.reload.no_server.body:
The server is not running; the configuration will take effect on next start.

To apply it online, start the server on the Runtime & Logs page first.
shop.reload.confirm.title: Confirm shop reload
shop.reload.confirm.body:
This sends dbreload (not shopreload).

· shopreload does not clear the old list; every use doubles the products and causes duplicate products and shifted prices in the client shop.
· dbreload rebuilds all Managers and pushes the shop to online users again.
· If Shop.json has a syntax error, the server shuts down immediately (the tool validates it first).

Continue?
shop.reload.sent.title: Sent
shop.reload.sent.body:
dbreload has been sent.

Confirm on the Runtime & Logs page that the following appears:
  [Shop] Loaded N products
N should match the product count on this page; if it is much larger, duplicate loading has occurred.
config.title: Server Configuration
config.desc: Controlled editing of ServerConfig.json and launcher.ini. Ports and contextual dependencies are validated before saving.
config.listen_note: Listen address is fixed at 0.0.0.0 and cannot be changed; port changes require a server restart.
config.auth_hint: Changing the port synchronizes AuthServer/config.json, Launcher/config.json, and GM_Tool/config.json; the launcher needs no manual edit.
config.metadata_count: Controls which tables clients receive · {count} items
config.footer: Saving automatically backs up the previous ServerConfig.json and launcher.ini; dbreload rebuilds all Managers, and an invalid configuration shuts the server down immediately.
config.port_invalid.title: Invalid port
config.port_invalid.body: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535
config.port_conflict.title: Port conflict
config.port_conflict.body: The authentication service and the game server cannot share port {port}; choose another.
config.auth_restart.title: Auth restart required
config.auth_restart.body:
The authentication service is running ({port}).

It must be restarted after changing the port; players cannot log in during that time. Continue?
config.port_used.title: Port in use
config.port_used.body: Port {port} is already used by another program; choose another.
config.auth_applied.title: Applied
config.auth_applied.body:
The authentication port has been set to {port} and synchronized to:
  · AuthServer/config.json
  · Launcher/config.json
  · GM_Tool/config.json

{restart}
config.auth_need_start: Click "Start auth" to restart the service.
config.kill_confirm.title: Force kill
config.kill_confirm.body:
Terminate the process directly; no maintenance notice is sent and online player state is not saved.

Use only when the server is frozen and does not respond to shutdown. Continue?
config.validation_failed.title: Validation failed
config.server_port_invalid: The server port must be a number from 1 to 65535
config.choose_from_list: {field}: please choose a value from the dropdown
config.client_invalid.title: Invalid client address
config.saved.title: Saved
config.saved.body:
ServerConfig.json and launcher.ini have been written.

{port_warning}Click "Reload server data" to apply online.
config.port_warning: ⚠ The port has changed and the server must be restarted for it to take effect.
config.dbreload.no_server.title: Server not running
config.dbreload.no_server.body: The configuration will take effect on next start.
config.dbreload.confirm.title: Confirm reload
config.dbreload.confirm.body:
dbreload rebuilds all Managers and re-reads all configuration and databases.

It is officially marked as a dangerous command: an invalid configuration shuts the server down immediately.

Continue?
config.dbreload.sent.title: Sent
config.dbreload.sent.body: dbreload has been sent; check the result on the Runtime & Logs page.
logs.title: Runtime & Logs
logs.desc: Start/stop the server, send console commands, and view live output and the tool-side audit trail.
logs.command_sent: >> {command} (sent; the result will appear in the file log below)
logs.stop_confirm.title: Confirm shutdown
logs.stop_confirm.body:
Send shutdown to the server:

· First broadcast the popup "Server down for maintenance" to all players
· Then gracefully shut down all Managers

Continue?
logs.cmd.status: Server status: memory / online count / uptime
logs.cmd.shopreload: ⚠ Broken command: does not clear the old list and doubles products; use dbreload
logs.cmd.dbreload: Reload all Managers (Shutdown then Init; correctly reloads the shop)
logs.cmd.sendnotice: sendnotice <text>: broadcast a popup to all players
logs.cmd.giverewardtoall: giverewardtoall <rewardID>: give a reward package to all registered users
authlog.title: Security Log
authlog.desc: Failed logins, rate limiting, and credential-stuffing sources from the authentication service. Summarize by IP and ban with one click.
authlog.double_hint: Double-click a row to filter events for that IP
authlog.auto_note: Automatic bans are permanent once written to IPBanList; unban manually
authlog.not_configured: Authentication service not configured: set auth_base_url and auth_api_key in config.json
authlog.select_ip: Please select an IP in the table above first
authlog.ban_confirm.title: Confirm IP ban
authlog.ban_confirm.body:
Add {ip} to IPBanList?

· Takes effect immediately: the server rejects this IP at TCP connection setup
· It also prevents this IP from registering new accounts
· If this is a shared IP (internet cafe), other players may be affected
authlog.banned.title: Banned
authlog.banned.body: {ip} has been added to the IP blacklist
authlog.not_configured.title: Not configured
authlog.not_configured.body:
Set the following in GM_Tool/config.json:
  "auth_base_url": "http://your-server:8080",
  "auth_api_key": "the same key as the authentication service"
authlog.health.title: Authentication service healthy
